description: Source code defining a Point class with methods for geometric operations, used in the Leaflet mapping library.

classes.name: Point
classes.description: Represents a 2D point with x and y coordinates, including methods for cloning, arithmetic operations, scaling, rounding, distance calculation, and comparison.

methods.name: Point
methods.description: Constructor for creating a Point with x and y coordinates, with optional rounding.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Returns a copy of the current point.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds another point to this point and returns a new Point.

methods.name: _add
methods.description: Internal method to add another point to this point destructively.

methods.name: subtract
methods.description: Subtracts another point from this point and returns a new Point.

methods.name: _subtract
methods.description: Internal method to subtract another point destructively.

methods.name: divideBy
methods.description: Divides this point by a number and returns a new Point.

methods.name: _divideBy
methods.description: Internal method to divide this point destructively.

methods.name: multiplyBy
methods.description: Multiplies this point by a number and returns a new Point.

methods.name: _multiplyBy
methods.description: Internal method to multiply this point destructively.

methods.name: scaleBy
methods.description: Scales this point by another point (coordinate-wise) and returns a new Point.

methods.name: unscaleBy
methods.description: Inverse of scaleBy, dividing each coordinate by another point.

methods.name: round
methods.description: Returns a new Point with rounded coordinates.

methods.name: _round
methods.description: Internal method to round coordinates destructively.

methods.name: floor
methods.description: Returns a new Point with floored coordinates.

methods.name: _floor
methods.description: Internal method to floor coordinates destructively.

methods.name: ceil
methods.description: Returns a new Point with ceiled coordinates.

methods.name: _ceil
methods.description: Internal method to ceil coordinates destructively.

methods.name: trunc
methods.description: Returns a new Point with truncated coordinates.

methods.name: _trunc
methods.description: Internal method to truncate coordinates destructively.

methods.name: distanceTo
methods.description: Calculates the Euclidean distance to another point.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if another point has the same coordinates.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if another point's absolute coordinates are within this point's absolute coordinates.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the point.
